xBRIEFInfo.description: Harden review-cycle OpenClaw Approach 1: empty/unknown settle is not done; single review-monitor lease; required non-empty STATUS handback.

plan.title: fix(review-cycle,openclaw): empty announce ≠ done + single review-monitor lease

narratives.Description: Residual after #2874/#2876: parents treat empty/unknown subagent settles as terminal and respawn a second review-monitor. Harden post-spawn ownership and empty-settle DoD in review-cycle skill, host-openclaw adapter, and poller/preamble templates.
narratives.UserStory: As a swarm parent on OpenClaw, I want empty review-monitor settles and dual leases to be forbidden by skill MUST rules, so that babysit does not thrash with dual ownership while the PR stays open.
narratives.ImplementationPlan: Step 1: Edit the skill module file content/skills/deft-directive-review-cycle/SKILL.md to add MUST rules for empty/unknown settle (same-turn ground-truth, FC04) and single review-owner lease with pre-spawn check. Step 2: Update the Approach 1 monitor prompt template file under content/skills/deft-directive-review-cycle/ (or references/) with required non-empty STATUS/HEAD/CHECKS/MERGE handback. Step 3: Cross-link the host-openclaw adapter file content/skills/deft-directive-swarm/references/host-openclaw.md and content/templates/agent-prompt-preamble.md. Step 4: Add recurrence lesson and CHANGELOG #3044. Step 5: Verify with task agents:refresh if needed, content contract tests if present, and full task check before opening the PR.
narratives.Overview: Skill/template residual: empty announce ≠ done + single review-monitor lease on OpenClaw Approach 1.
narratives.Labels: bug, enhancement, skills, operational, agent-experience, review-cycle, harness:openclaw
narratives.NonGoals: Re-open #2874 Tier-1 matrix; fix OpenClaw host empty-announce root cause; multi-reviewer swarm rewrite #769; force admin merge.

narrative.Acceptance: Given a review-monitor settle with empty body, missing STATUS, or status unknown, when the parent continues, skill MUST language requires same-turn ground-truth tools and forbids treating the settle as DONE/CLEAN/merge-ready (FC04 cite).

Given Approach 1 review-monitor spawn, when a prior owner is running or last settle was empty/unknown without terminal ground truth, skill MUST forbid a second monitor; monitor prompt template requires non-empty STATUS/HEAD/CHECKS/MERGE handback; OpenClaw host adapter/docs cross-link this residual.
Given skill Recurrence or meta/lessons and CHANGELOG [Unreleased], when the PR lands, enterprize#43 2026-08-02 is cited and CHANGELOG cites #3044.

expected_outputs: review-cycle MUST empty-settle DoD + single lease
